name: AI keys
author: Brett
description: A dialog that keeps several Anthropic keys (API keys sk-ant-api… and Claude subscription tokens sk-ant-oat… from `claude setup-token`) and picks the active one of each kind for the AI assistant. Every key is tested before it is saved (an invalid one is refused) and can be re-tested; keys are stored 0600 on the console server and never sent back to a browser (only the last 4 characters). The active key replaces the assistant profile's own key for that kind (Anthropic / Claude Code subscription). Open it from the right-click menu, the application menu (Plugins › AI keys), action ai-keys.open, search or Settings → Plugins → AI keys; reachable through axHub's sign-in wall and inside Patches like the rest of the console.
